name: shop_1f
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. The attached image is an EXACT geometry control image. Build one early Qing Jiangnan SINGLE STOREY SHOP on this footprint, following the control image's ground outline exactly. Ground shape is7 by5 meters, ground axis slopes +0.5 and -0.5, orthographic 2:1 game-map projection. Do not redesign or recenter the ground rectangle. Show the exact same 3 front stone foundation corners as control image. Replace grid with realistic thin stone paving; front facade follows lower-left-facing edge, right side follows right edge. A modest open wooden merchandise counter, bamboo blind under eave, timber shelving, no signage. White plaster end walls with restrained raised gables, grey clay tile roof and dark timber. Realistic subdued fine-textured old materials, no cartoon. The base occupies the same fixed area and border as input. Roof and walls only rise vertically ABOVE the fixed base. Keep each wall horizontal edge precisely parallel to the two ground directions, never 30degree isometric. Pale sun from upper-left, very short subtle contact shadow lower-right. Transparent background, opaque subject, no text no watermark no people no modern objects. Everything fits complete inside image, ample transparent border.
